title: 45:1 his anointed. The kings of Israel were known as "the anointed of Jehovah"; they were anointed with oil at their coronation. Cyrus was made king, or leader, over God's people (1 Sam. 10:1; 16:13; 1 Kgs. 1:39; 2 Kgs. 9: 3, 6). But there may be a second meaning here: the Hebrew word anointed becomes Messiah in English and Christ in Greek. By calling Cyrus his anointed, the Lord may be pointing out that Cyrus is a type of Christ. In addition, the anointed may be interpreted to mean any of God's servants who are anointed to do his work.
author: Tina M. Peterson
